title: Count the laboratory results
hook: Two stated cases: explore the denominator behind a replication share.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the denominator behind a replication share affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Share, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the denominator behind a replication share in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
